description: Full-batch regression comparison of every selected circuit (1,863 total: SC8+WH10+WH16) against its staged, previously-executed QPY file, at both a strict structural (gate-by-gate) tier and a measurement-probability-equivalence tier. See code/src/holographic_codes/circuits/comparison.py for the two tiers' definitions and code/tests/test_circuit_regression.py for the representative-sample regression test that runs by default under pytest.
